# Uncle Cat AI Radar

> Uncle Cat AI Radar（中文名：猫叔的AI资讯雷达）is an autonomous, source-linked AI news radar by Uncle Cat. It publishes bilingual AI briefings and quick-hit radar updates on models, research, products, policy, open source, safety, funding, and industry, with original source links and timestamps.

Canonical site: https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/
Publisher: Uncle Cat (https://x.com/mmlong8)
Former names: AI Focus Bulletin, AI专注速报
Languages: English and zh-CN
Update cadence: twice daily around 07:00 and 19:00 Beijing time
Access policy: public, free, no ads, no trackers, no paywall

## Latest briefings

- [Google Maps the Effects of Nine Billion DNA Variants](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/alphagenome-atlas-maps-dna-variants.html): Google DeepMind’s AlphaGenome Atlas predicts the molecular impact of every possible single-letter change in human DNA and opens the resource to academic researchers.
- [Cognition Raises $2 Billion at a $48 Billion Valuation](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/cognition-series-e-devin.html): Devin maker Cognition has raised more than $2 billion, giving the coding-agent company a $48 billion valuation as enterprise adoption accelerates.
- [Meta Expands Its Personal AI Assistant With Muse Spark](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/meta-muse-personal-agent.html): Meta is expanding its personal AI assistant across its products, powered by Muse Spark models that support multimodal reasoning, tool use and longer-horizon tasks.
- [OpenAI Ships Images 2.5 With More Precise Editing](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-images-2-5.html): OpenAI has released Images 2.5 across ChatGPT and its API, combining faster generation with stronger reference fidelity and multi-turn editing.
- [OpenAI Claims AI-Generated Proof for Navier–Stokes](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/openai-navier-stokes-proof.html): OpenAI says an unreleased model and 10,000 agents produced a Lean-verified Navier–Stokes proof, but mathematicians have yet to validate it independently.
- [Mistral Raises €3 Billion to Expand Sovereign AI](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/mistral-3b-sovereign-ai-bet.html): Mistral’s record European funding round gives its open-weight strategy unprecedented capital, while tying Samsung and Europe more closely to frontier AI.
- [AI-Designed Drug Shifts Six Biological-Age Clocks](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/rentosertib-shifts-aging-clocks.html): A small lung-disease trial links rentosertib to younger proteomic readings, but cannot yet distinguish treatment effects from slower aging.
- [South Korea Weighs Nuclear Expansion as AI Lifts Power Demand](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/south-korea-ai-power-nuclear.html): South Korea expects AI data centers and chip fabs to add up to 30 gigawatts of demand, pushing nuclear power back into the national AI strategy.
- [HiDream Launches Embodied Model for Robot Robustness](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/hidream-embodied-robot-world-model.html): HiDream’s new world model unifies vision, video, 3D and actions, targeting robots that remain reliable under environmental disruption.
- [Claude Fable 5.1 Tops Agent Arena on 6,796 Sessions](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/fable-5-1-agent-arena-lead.html): Anthropic’s model leads a live agent benchmark, although its strong task results come with the board’s highest median cost.
- [DeepSeek Plans 160,000-Chip Huawei AI Cluster](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/deepseek-huawei-chip-cluster.html): DeepSeek reportedly plans a vast Ascend deployment in Inner Mongolia, testing whether Chinese hardware can sustain frontier-scale inference.
- [Gimlet Labs Raises $300M for Distributed AI Inference](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/gimlet-disaggregated-inference-funding.html): Gimlet’s large Series B backs software that pools heterogeneous accelerators as inference buyers seek alternatives to fixed GPU clusters.
- [GitHub HydraFusion Routes Coding Work Across Models](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/github-hydrafusion-model-routing.html): GitHub’s experimental coding agent selects single, cascade or critique workflows to trade model cost against verified task quality.
- [Google Expands Lyria 3.5 Across Gemini and API](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/google-lyria-global-expansion.html): Google has moved its latest music model into global consumer and developer channels, widening access beyond its earlier Flow Music launch.
- [Microsoft Adds Fast MAI-Image Model to Foundry](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/articles/microsoft-mai-image-flash.html): MAI-Image-2.6-Flash pairs lower prices with production-focused editing, while the full model leads a major third-party benchmark.

## Latest Chinese briefings

- [谷歌发布图谱，预测90亿种DNA变异影响](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/alphagenome-atlas-maps-dna-variants.html): Google DeepMind推出AlphaGenome Atlas，为人类基因组约90亿种单字母变异提供分子影响预测，并向学术研究人员开放。
- [Devin开发商Cognition获20亿美元，估值480亿美元](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/cognition-series-e-devin.html): Devin开发商Cognition完成超过20亿美元融资，估值达到480亿美元，投资者押注企业将扩大编程智能体使用。
- [Meta借助Muse Spark扩展个人AI助手](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/meta-muse-personal-agent.html): Meta正在扩展跨产品的个人AI助手，由Muse Spark模型提供多模态推理、工具调用和长流程任务能力。
- [OpenAI发布Images 2.5，强化精准编辑能力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-images-2-5.html): OpenAI将Images 2.5推向ChatGPT和API，重点提升参考图一致性、多轮编辑稳定性与生成速度。
- [OpenAI称人工智能模型提出纳维–斯托克斯证明](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/openai-navier-stokes-proof.html): OpenAI称一款未公开模型协同约1万名智能体生成并形式化验证纳维–斯托克斯证明，但外部数学家尚未独立确认。
- [Mistral获30亿欧元融资，押注主权开放权重AI](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/mistral-3b-sovereign-ai-bet.html): 这笔欧洲科技公司史上最大股权融资，将为Mistral的开放权重路线注入巨额算力资本，并把三星更深地拉入前沿AI竞争。
- [AI设计药物令六种生物年龄时钟同步回调](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/rentosertib-shifts-aging-clocks.html): 一项小规模肺病试验显示，Rentosertib令六种蛋白质组年龄指标下降，但尚无法排除疾病改善带来的影响。
- [AI推高韩国用电需求，核电扩张重新进入议程](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/south-korea-ai-power-nuclear.html): 韩国预计AI数据中心和芯片工厂将新增25至30吉瓦用电需求，政府因此重新评估核电在AI基础设施中的角色。
- [智象发布具身世界模型，强化机器人抗干扰能力](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/hidream-embodied-robot-world-model.html): HiDream-O1-Embodied统一表征图像、视频、三维与动作信息，瞄准复杂环境下更稳定的机器人感知和执行。
- [Claude Fable 5.1登顶智能体实战榜单](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/fable-5-1-agent-arena-lead.html): Claude Fable 5.1在6796次真实智能体会话中排名第一，但领先表现伴随着榜单最高的单任务成本。
- [DeepSeek拟建16万颗昇腾芯片超大集群](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/deepseek-huawei-chip-cluster.html): DeepSeek据报计划在内蒙古部署至少16万颗华为昇腾芯片，检验国产算力能否支撑前沿模型的大规模推理。
- [Gimlet Labs融资3亿美元押注解耦式AI推理](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/gimlet-disaggregated-inference-funding.html): Gimlet以超大额B轮融资扩张异构推理平台，试图把不同芯片和内存资源组织成可统一调度的算力池。
- [GitHub推出多模型编程调度系统HydraFusion](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/github-hydrafusion-model-routing.html): HydraFusion可按任务选择单模型、逐级升级或交叉审查流程，在编程质量、成本和延迟之间动态取舍。
- [谷歌将Lyria 3.5推向Gemini及开发者平台](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/google-lyria-global-expansion.html): 谷歌把Lyria 3.5从早期Flow Music入口扩展至全球Gemini用户、AI Studio和API，显著扩大音乐生成覆盖面。
- [微软在Foundry上线MAI-Image-2.6双模型](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/articles/microsoft-mai-image-flash.html): 微软以完整版争夺图像编辑质量榜首，并用Flash版本降低生成成本，强化Foundry的企业图像生产能力。

- [全部简报（中文）](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/zh/): Chinese edition

- [RSS English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss.xml) / [RSS 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/rss-zh.xml): machine-readable feeds
- [JSON Feed English](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed.json) / [JSON Feed 中文](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/feed-zh.json): structured article feed with source URLs
- [Archive](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/archive.html): calendar of every day's briefings and quick hits, with search
- [Latest radar page](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/radar/2026-09-09.html): one-sentence quick hits with timestamps and sources
- [Full LLM context](https://mmlong818.github.io/ai-pulse/llms-full.txt): expanded machine-readable digest of recent stories and sources

## Source and citation policy

- Every article has a stable canonical URL, a Chinese alternate URL, visible source links, JSON-LD NewsArticle metadata, and machine-readable citation URLs.
- Use the original source links on each article for factual verification.
- Treat this site as an original synthesis and monitoring layer, not as the primary source when a linked company, paper, filing, or official post is available.
- If referencing a quick hit from X or another social source, preserve its timestamp and original URL.
